authority: Continuing coordinator allocation b53f1ba8-e798-479a-9df2-d09c7b759843 and distinct cross-asset mechanism lead 1dd31aaf-49de-4955-941d-908ff4c3f03b. Shared extractor coordination 6f61369b-0644-497a-9c32-c932810a4a70.
question: Does same-venue BTC observed-frame order-flow imbalance improve delayed target forecasts and closed cash after controlling for own flow and BTC returns, trades and queue endpoints?
mechanism_hypothesis: Portfolio demand may propagate across assets over time. A BTC queue-transition path could contain predictive information not contained in the target's own state or BTC's endpoint state. Trader linkage and structural causality are unobserved; this tests a conditional forecast, not causal leadership inferred from update ordering.

research_context.interpretation: The equity study motivates a conditional lagged-flow comparison. It does not establish delayed, costed crypto profitability. Our batched observations are a transition proxy rather than the full event-level order flow observed in exchange message data.
research_context.distinct_from_parked_v1: No BTC-return trigger or quiet-target rescue. The unchanged return-lag mechanism remains parked after its frozen availability audit. Every fixed calendar anchor is eligible for the new diagnostic.

cohort.selection: All same-venue leader-target cells, separately fit. No cell, venue, size, sign or model winner selection.

calendar_and_data.feature_window: Completed receipt interval (t-1s,t], with the shared extractor's exact boundary/grouping rules frozen before use.
calendar_and_data.causality: Own and same-venue BTC features are both known at calendar t; target prediction begins at the shared delayed entry. Reset across captures and invalidations; never stitch missing history or fills.
calendar_and_data.data_role: Exploratory historical blocks, not untouched validation. No reserved inputs.
calendar_and_data.transfer: Prefer one immutable bounded shared feature/label/quote table with causal provenance, and reuse its parser/schema. Current peer raw export covers only chunks1-3; additional raw transfer requires coordinator allocation.

features_and_models.normalization: Each market uses D_start=(bidQty_start+askQty_start)/2 from its own feature-window start.
five_non_ofi_controls: own backward mid return over the completed window
ordinary-trade imbalance over the completed window
features_and_models.flow: Shared source's standard best-queue transition sum divided by D_start, explicitly labelled observed-frame OFI.
features_and_models.M0: Intercept plus target five controls plus target OFI: 7 parameters. Descriptive own-market reference.
features_and_models.M1: M0 plus same-venue BTC five non-OFI controls: 12 parameters. Primary reference.
features_and_models.M2: M1 plus same-venue BTC OFI: 13 parameters. Primary candidate.
features_and_models.primary_comparison: M2 versus M1 only; M1 versus M0 is descriptive. All models use identical complete M2-feature and label rows within each cell.
features_and_models.fit: Fixed OLS; fit-only standardization; no tuning, refitting, alternative lag, coefficient-sign reversal or regularization rescue after application.
features_and_models.endpoint_identity: With unchanged best prices, summed OFI telescopes to the change in queue differences. BTC start and current endpoints therefore belong in M1. Rank failure after these controls is missing incremental support, not a reason to drop the controls.

support_gates.rank: Require full numerical rank and nonzero frozen training-label variance. Exact solver, scaling, tolerances and finite-number rules await the shared source contract and must be fixed before features.
support_gates.failure: Report every missing/rank/zero-variance cell and calendar reason. An incomplete broad cohort is inconclusive; do not silently form an easier subset. Missing data or failed execution is never flat cash.

forecast_decision.metric: Squared forecast error normalized by each cell's frozen training-label variance. Equal weights across the fixed18cells, then across the3application chunks, on a common calendar support.
forecast_decision.advance_requirement: Positive M2-vs-M1 loss improvement in every application chunk. Leave-one-application-chunk-out aggregates are reported descriptively; they add no independent evidence when every equally weighted chunk is positive.
forecast_decision.dependence: Shared BTC observations, simultaneous targets and adjacent chunks are dependent. No pooled iid significance claim. Record calendar support and block results rather than multiplying evidence by the number of assets.

economic_decision.contract: Reuse the shared frozen target label, action gate, sizing, native constraints, endpoint selection, fees, funding exclusion and failure/accounting rules exactly. The contract is pending; this draft authorizes no calculation.
economic_decision.advance_requirement: On the same declared accounting support, positive absolute M2 closed cash and positive paired M2-minus-M1 cash in every application chunk for every fixed size arm, plus the forecast criterion. Report all arms and no selected winner. An unavailable requested economic leg is missing evidence and cannot improve the aggregate by exclusion.
economic_decision.interpretation: Alternative size/model ledgers are not one simultaneously executable portfolio. Passing supports only proposing later untouched replication; it is not strategy validation or promotion.

execution_boundaries.feature_preflight: Use causal feature coverage and rank first. If this fails the broad support gate, report the failed cells and park without peer forward-outcome evaluation.
execution_boundaries.scope: No collector, authenticated API, wallet, order, root-owned economics change, reserved input, push or main merge.

required_before_freeze: Read and pin the reviewed shared extractor and its exact causal feature schema.
Resolve shared target-label, action, quantity, quote and accounting contracts without viewing their results.
Pin authorized input or immutable shared-table hashes and categories; use LFS for large retained files.
Specify numerical solver, rank tolerances, normalized-loss definition and source/skew/coverage rules.
Review the bounded implementation and focused causal/rank/failure checks.
Record a new source/protocol freeze before extracting or loading any new-study features/outcomes.
